The change will likely pass the hidden-box list test, but fail the hidden-box-by-code test.

`getVisibleContentBox` is applied to the method preceding the shown `@GetMapping("/content/boxes/{code}")` annotation. Therefore, the actual plural storefront endpoint appears unchanged and can still return hidden content. The existing test suite may compile, but the task-specific API checks should fail.
